## Summary of Changes

Provide a brief description of the changes in this pull request.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds functionality)
- [ ] New module (adds a new Maximo module integration)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation (updates to docs, comments, or README)
- [ ] Refactoring (no functional changes, code quality improvements)

## Testing

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated
- [ ] Integration tests added or updated
- [ ] All existing tests pass (`npm test`)
- [ ] Coverage meets the 70% threshold (`npm run test:coverage`)

## Checklist

- [ ] Code follows the project style and conventions
- [ ] TypeScript strict mode passes (`npm run type-check`)
- [ ] No linting errors (`npm run lint`)
- [ ] Documentation updated (if applicable)
- [ ] No hardcoded credentials, API keys, or URLs
